_comment: Default activities generated onto weapons, by rate of fire, plus the detonation an explosive gets in place of a shot. One source of truth: scripts/build_packs.py writes these into the compendium, and scripts/gen_activity_defaults.py generates module/activity-defaults.mjs so new and legacy items get the same thing. Each entry cites the SRD phrase it encodes.

automatic.name: MODERN20.Attack.Autofire
automatic._cites: The character targets a 10-foot-by-10-foot area and makes an attack roll; the targeted area has an effective Defense of 10. Autofire uses ten bullets.

automatic.name: MODERN20.Attack.Burst
automatic._cites: When using an automatic firearm with at least five bullets loaded ... a -4 penalty on the attack roll, but deal +2 dice of damage.

explosive.name: MODERN20.Attack.Detonate
explosive._cites: An explosive ... affects all creatures and objects within its burst radius. Any creature caught within the burst radius may make a Reflex save against the DC given in this column for half damage.
